sentences.text: The Corruption and Crime Commission and WA Police jointly examined property handling after investigations exposed deficiencies in police property management.
sentences.support: it was agreed that the WA Police and the Corruption and Crime Commission would undertake a joint inquiry

sentences.text: The inquiry assessed procedures and processes against good practice and considered ways to prevent property-related corruption and misconduct.
sentences.support: assess the adequacy of police procedures and processes for managing property against recognised standards of good property practice

sentences.text: It found weaknesses in storage security, record systems, auditing, resources and staff understanding of their responsibilities.
sentences.support: The Inquiry determined that property officers and, indeed, their supervisors, generally did not fully understand their responsibilities for the function.

sentences.text: Its 42 recommendations covered central management, staffing and training, funding, storage, systems, procedures and legislation.
sentences.support: The 42 recommendations made in this report are far-reaching for WA Police.

sentences.text: The inquiry recommended giving civilian staff property management duties that did not require police powers.
sentences.support: Western Australia Police should civilianise positions that undertake property management duties as a primary job function and do not require police powers.

findings.quote: The Inquiry found that there are no recognised national standards for police property management, which contrasts with the many legislative requirements impacting on the subject.
The Inquiry determined that property officers and, indeed, their supervisors, generally did not fully understand their responsibilities for the function.
